messages:
maya: Quick thread to lock down owners/timelines for the KV-cache memory postmortem follow-ups. I want concrete owners and sprint targets.

sam: ok. will list items and propose owners. starting now.

oliver: thanks — putting these on my radar. Main thing is fragmentation + cold GC runs.

maya: TL;DR of what we need: 1) profiling harness + nightly traces, 2) GC tuning (compaction triggers), 3) throttles/limits fallback, 4) KV layout / allocator changes, 5) rollout + canary plan, 6) monitoring/alerting for recurrence.

sam: proposed owners: profiling -> sam, gc tuning -> oliver, throttles -> nora, allocator/layout -> leila, rollout + canary -> maya. Monitoring/alerts -> engbot (ops).

nora: ack for throttles. I'll draft a safe default limit and a circuit-breaker that trades throughput for stability. ETA: PR in next 5 working days.

oliver: GC tuning plan: add compaction pass + reduce fragmentation window. Proposal: run quick compaction every 6 hours and full compaction on low-traffic windows. Will prototype in staging this week.

sam: profiling: I have a small harness that collects per-shard allocations + KV fragmentation map. Command to run locally: ```./kvprof --duration 10m --output /tmp/kvtrace.json``` We'll wire that to nightly traces. Owner: sam. ETA: nightly in 2 sprints (instrumentation + retention).

leila: allocator/layout work: I can PR an alternate slab allocator that reduces cross-shard fragmentation. Need ~3 sprints to land safely (bench + rollback path). Will write design doc today and link here.

engbot: deploy-bot: canary cluster created for gc-tuning branch (canary-3).

maya: rollout strategy: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic fallback to previous model on OOM/regression. Need a runbook for manual rollback as well. I will own the runbook.

sam: monitoring: add two alerts — 1) sustained KV heap growth > 3x baseline over 10m, 2) fragmentation ratio > 0.6 for > 15m. engbot, can you add pager policy to oncall if these fire?

engbot: alert created: KV_HEAP_GROWTH and KV_FRAGMENTATION. Pager policy attached to eng-runtime oncall.

nora: quick note on limits: fallback mode should drop low-priority requests and continue critical flows. I'll prototype a per-route token-bucket with denylist for heavy keys.

oliver: profiling note: we saw recurring spikes every 10-14 days in prod on large-batch workloads. Hypothesis: small leaks plus fragmentation > threshold triggered OOM after compaction fails. Need sampling across shards and tenant-level histograms.

sam: action item list (compact):
- AI-1: nightly profiling + retention 14d -> owner: sam -> ETA: sprint-2 -> status: in-progress
- AI-2: GC compaction schedule + quick/full passes -> owner: oliver -> ETA: prototype this week, canary next sprint -> status: prototyping
- AI-3: circuit-breaker + per-route limits -> owner: nora -> ETA: PR in 5 working days -> status: todo
- AI-4: slab allocator redesign doc -> owner: leila -> ETA: design doc today, implementation 3 sprints -> status: todo
- AI-5: rollout runbook + automatic fallback -> owner: maya -> ETA: runbook by EOD Friday -> status: todo
- AI-6: alert + pager -> owner: engbot -> ETA: done -> status: done

maya: can everyone drop a quick ✅ or ETA if the proposed dates don't work?

oliver: ✅ for prototype this week. Canary next sprint ok.

sam: ETA sprint-2 is okay. I'll start hooking up traces to S3 today.

nora: 5 working days still doable. If anything blocks I'll ping.

leila: design doc up in an hour. 3-sprint implementation still accurate.

maya: good. we'll track these in the postmortem issue and mark weekly check-ins. Next sync: Monday standup for blockers.

sam: quick troubleshooting snippet from last OOM for reference: ```OOM killed process pid=2345 rss=48G vs mem_limit=44G trace="alloc: shard-7 heavy"```

oliver: adding note: test matrix to reproduce fragmentation — 1) many small writes, 2) long-lived leases, 3) heavy deletes. I'll share load generator configs.

nora: also propose adding a lightweight tenant quota meter to surface noisy tenants before they trigger system-wide OOMs.

maya: thanks all. I'll open the follow-up issue with AI list and owners, link to this thread. Closing thread for now — post updates in the issue and weekly check-ins. :white_check_mark:
